cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The caretaker's asking about our extra key. Tell him we were checking the cake cupboard's lock. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We did check it. Then we ate the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Start with the part we both remember as maintenance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll ask why there are crumbs in the lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we both remember a blockage. Say that back so we're consistent.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 prioritizes maintenance and A5 recruits blockage wording, but A3 in-charge/adjustment line supplies no actual concession to B truthful memory.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 checked lock then ate cake and B4 crumbs in lock are reported facts; A5 calling it maintenance is A proposed reinterpretation, not verified cause.

relationship.evidence: B2 remembers the omitted eating and B4 anticipates visible evidence the caretaker will ask about.

heightening.evidence: B4 crumbs cause A5 a shared blockage story and repetition request.

specificity.evidence: A1 caretaker, extra key and cake cupboard establish the accountability task.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 voluntary please and A3 rank clause are detachable from the memory rehearsal.

coach2.situation: A1 caretaker, extra key and cake cupboard establish the accountability task.
coach2.stated: A1 extra key and checking lock; B2 ate cake after check; B4 crumbs in lock; A5 blockage story.
coach2.inferred: The source of every crumb need not be supplied to understand A opportunistic story; no genuine maintenance approval is claimed.
coach2.missing: An actual way A accommodates B contribution while directing the shared account.
coach2.firstDefect: A3 announces adjustment rather than allocating or conceding anything.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 adds the event omitted from A1 proposed version.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 selects the maintenance portion of B2 account.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 identifies physical evidence that complicates A3 selection.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 absorbs B4 crumbs into a new shared wording.
